description: modules -> register.ts (mods hooks module, in-process, no per-call process): a tool.call hook on Bash is a router — read-only gather commands (bare curl GETs, >=3-segment text-tool chains, >=3-stage text pipelines) are denied with a copy-ready replacement call on context-mode's ctx_fetch_and_index / ctx_batch_execute / ctx_execute (steer_enabled toggle); everything else is rewritten to its rtk equivalent through the managed ~/.local/bin/rtk (auto_rewrite toggle). A tool.call hook on WebFetch denies every WebFetch with a ctx_fetch_and_index + ctx_search replacement (steer_enabled toggle). Pure policy: hooks/rtk-rewrite.mjs. SessionStart -> server.mjs --session-start-hook (command hook: mcp_tool hard-errors pre-connect), SubagentStart -> hook_subagent_context, PreToolUse Grep|Glob -> hook_symbol_context, PostToolUse Read -> hook_coverage_context: fail-open, context-only codebase-memory-mcp graph context served as mcp_tool hooks by this plugin's own codebase-memory proxy MCP server (mcp/server.mjs). Second SessionStart entry -> cat hooks/SessionStart.md: injects the context-mode MCP server's own routing-rules document (upstream, verbatim) as session context on every startup/resume/clear/compact. Second SubagentStart entry -> cat hooks/subagent-nudge.json: a pre-rendered hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext JSON payload (SubagentStart command-hook stdout is NOT auto-delivered as context like SessionStart's -- it only reaches the debug log -- so the static payload must already be the JSON envelope) telling subagents to skip inter-tool-call narration and to prefer context-mode's ctx_* tools. Third SessionStart entry -> hooks/rtk-install.mjs: async command hook that installs the pinned, dual-sha256-verified rtk release into ~/.local/bin/rtk on first use (only when absent), gated by rtk_enabled. Seven classic hooks total, plus the module's two tool.call hooks.
